purpose: Include another item in the same statement.
keywords: Noun + も, often replacing は / が / を.
I told my younger sister too.
formation: Noun + も, often replacing は / が / を.
restrictions: Other particles can remain: にも, でも, とも.
mistake: Do not automatically replace every particle with も.
